questions.q: Mary made ____ mistakes in her last examination.
questions.zh: 瑪麗在她最後的考試中出了很多錯。
questions.explain: a lot of ＋ 複數名詞（許多）。

questions.q: She was desperate because there is ____ hope.
questions.zh: 她絕望了，因為沒有什麼希望。
questions.explain: little hope（沒希望）。little 修飾不可數名詞且具否定意味。

questions.q: They ate ____ loaves of bread this morning.
questions.zh: 他們今天早晨吃了許多條麵包。
questions.explain: a lot of ＋ 複數名詞／或不可數名詞。loaves 為可數名詞複數。

questions.q: Since they are moving to a new house, they have to buy ____ furniture.
questions.zh: 因為他們搬到新家，所以他們必須買許多家具。
questions.explain: furniture（家具）為不可數名詞，用 a lot of 修飾。

questions.q: It is very probable that you spend ____ time in the laboratory every day.
questions.zh: 你每天在實驗室待很久是很有可能的。
questions.explain: a lot of ＋ 不可數名詞或複數名詞。time 在此為不可數名詞。

questions.q: I have just finished a very ____ story.
questions.zh: 我剛看完一篇有趣的故事。
questions.explain: 用 interesting（有趣的）修飾事物（story）。

questions.q: His teacher seemed to ____ his composition.
questions.zh: 他的老師似乎對他的作文感到滿意。
questions.explain: 人 be satisfied with 事（對～感到滿意）。

questions.q: I felt ____ by his interest.
questions.zh: 我受到他的關心所鼓勵。
questions.explain: 連綴動詞 (feel) ＋ 形容詞／過去分詞（主詞補語）。

questions.q: They felt quite ____ when they reached the top of the mountain.
questions.zh: 他們到達山頂時，覺得相當累。
questions.explain: 連綴動詞 (feel) ＋ 形容詞／過去分詞（主詞補語）。

questions.q: I ____ at learning of the truth.
questions.zh: 獲知真相使我感到驚訝。
questions.explain: 人 be surprised at 事物（對…感到驚訝）。

questions.q: I didn't enjoy the party because I ____.
questions.zh: 我不喜歡參加宴會，因為我對宴會感到厭煩。
questions.explain: 表示「情緒」的動詞以「過去分詞」作主詞補語，修飾主詞（人）。

questions.q: The lazy boy always feels ____ during classes.
questions.zh: 這個懶惰的男孩上課時總是想睡覺。
questions.explain: feel sleepy（想睡的），fall asleep（睡著的）。

questions.q: The king had only this beautiful ____ princess.
questions.zh: 國王只有這一位漂亮的金髮公主。
questions.explain: golden-haired（金黃色的頭髮）。形容詞 ─ 名詞-ed 形成複合形容詞。

questions.q: You would have to put almost a spoonful of sugar in a glass of water to make it taste ____.
questions.zh: 你必須把將近一湯匙的糖倒入一杯水中去，使它嚐起來甜甜的。
questions.explain: 連綴動詞 (taste) ＋ 形容詞。

questions.q: He looked ____.
questions.zh: 他看起來疲倦而且坐立不安。
questions.explain:
① 連綴動詞 (look) ＋ 形容詞（主詞補語）。
② (D) 要改為 excited and embarrassed 才能修飾人。

questions.q: You can learn ____ from everyone.
questions.zh: 你可以從每個人身上學到一些有益的東西。
questions.explain: something ＋ 形容詞（形容詞後位修飾複合代名詞）。

questions.q: About three ____ of the students were present.
questions.zh: 大約有五分之三的學生出席。
questions.explain: 「幾分之幾」➜ 分子用基數詞，分母用序數詞，分子 ＞ 1，分母加 s。

questions.q: The desk is ____ that one.
questions.zh: 這張書桌是那張書桌的兩倍長。
questions.explain: A ＋ 倍數 ＋ as ～ as ＋ B（A 是 B 的…倍～）。

questions.q: She is my ____ ten years.
questions.zh: 她比我大十歲。
questions.explain: A be senior to B / B's senior by 數字 year(s)（A 比 B 大…歲）。

questions.q: Glass is ____ plastic in making windows.
questions.zh: 在做窗戶方面，玻璃優於塑膠。
questions.explain: be better than ＋ 主格 ＝ be superior to ＋ 受格（優於）。

questions.q: A cow is ____ as a horse.
questions.zh: 牛和馬是一樣強壯的動物。
questions.explain: as ＋ 形容詞 ＋ a(n) ＋ 名詞 as（和…一樣）。

questions.q: Nobody else in her family is so ____ she is.
questions.zh: 她家裡再也沒有其他人比她更年輕了。
questions.explain: not so ＋ 原級 ＋ as（不如…一樣的…）。

questions.q: As Edison grew ____, he never lost his interest in science.
questions.zh: 當愛迪生漸漸長大，他始終未對科學失去興趣。
questions.explain: grow older（漸漸長大）。

questions.q: ____ to teach a man fishing than to give him fish.
questions.zh: 教一個人釣魚比給他魚要好。（給一個人魚不如教他如何捕魚。）
questions.explain: It is ＋ 形容詞 ＋ to ＋ V，因本句有 than，所以形容詞要用比較級 better。

questions.q: Beijing is ____ of the two cities.
questions.zh: 北京是兩個城市中較大的一個。
questions.explain: the ＋ 比較級 ＋ of the two...（兩者中較…的）。

questions.q: He is brighter than ____ in the class.
questions.zh: 他比班上所有其他男孩聰明。
questions.explain: 避免同一範圍內自己和自己比較，採用 any other ＋ 單數名詞 或 all (the) other ＋ 複數名詞。

questions.q: He may be a man of character, but he cannot be ____. (複選)
questions.zh: 他也許是一位有個性的人，但他不會是個能幹的人。
questions.explain: an able man（形容詞修飾名詞）＝ a man of ability（名詞 ability 作 of 的受詞）。

questions.q: "He has been on the medication." "The more he takes, ____ he becomes."
questions.zh: 「他一直在接受藥物治療。」「他接受的愈多，身體就變得愈好。」
questions.explain: the ＋ 比較級…, the ＋ 比較級…（愈…愈…）。

questions.q: You are ____ student in the school.
questions.zh: 你是學校裡最用功的學生。
questions.explain: the ＋ 最高級 ＋ ... ＋ of all... / in ＋ 場所。

questions.q: This is ____ plan I have ever made.
questions.zh: 這是我所做過的最糟的計劃。
questions.explain: the ＋ 最高級 ＋ ... ＋ (that) ＋ ... ever...（曾經…最…的）。

questions.q: Tom is regarded as ____ businessman in Chicago.
questions.zh: 湯姆被認為是芝加哥最有錢的商人。
questions.explain: the ＋ 最高級 ＋ ... ＋ of all... / in ＋ 場所。

questions.q: Are you ____ three sandwiches?
questions.zh: 你餓得能夠吃三個三明治嗎？
questions.explain: 形容詞／副詞 ＋ enough to ＋ 原形動詞（足以…）。

questions.q: The witness withheld ____ information from the police.
questions.zh: 證人拒絕向警方提供消息。
questions.explain: some ＋ 不可數名詞 (information)。

questions.q: She bought the house for fifty-thousand Yuan three years ago, but now it is worth ____ that amount.
questions.zh: 她三年前買那棟房子花了五萬元，但現在那棟房子所值超過原價的兩倍。
questions.explain: more than ＋ 倍數（超過…的幾倍）。

questions.q: Up in the mountains the air is ____ than it is in low lands.
questions.zh: 在高山上的空氣較低地稀薄而冷。
questions.explain: thin 的比較級 ➜ thinner（重複字尾加 er）；cold 的比較級 ➜ colder。

questions.q: We may have ____ vacation in the coming summer.
questions.zh: 即將來臨的暑假我們會有兩個月的假期。
questions.explain: 數字 ─ 單數名詞 作形容詞用。

questions.q: Such a competent man as he will be ____ of accomplishing this hard task.
questions.zh: 像他那麼有能力的人，將能完成這一艱巨的工作。
questions.explain: be capable of（有能力…）。be able 則接不定詞 to ＋ 原形動詞。

questions.q: Health is the last thing that ____.
questions.zh: 健康是財富所不能買到的東西。
questions.explain: the last ＋ 名詞 ＋ [to ＋ 原形動詞 / 關係子句]（最不可能）。

questions.q: John was ____ the daily routine of managing the factory. (複選)
questions.zh: 約翰對於處理工廠每天的例行公事不感興趣。
questions.explain: 人 be not interested in ＋ 事／物（對…不感興趣）＝ 人 be uninterested in ＋ 事／物。

questions.q: I enjoy teaching children. I have always found the work of a school teacher rather ____.
questions.zh: 我很喜歡教育小孩，我一直都覺得教師的工作頗為有趣。
questions.explain:
① (A) excited（感到興奮的），工作只能「令人興奮」，應改為 exciting。
② (B) funny（可笑的）。
③ (C) fun 在口語中常作 adj，意為「有趣的」。
④ (D) joking（開玩笑的）。

sections.title: （三）翻譯填充題
sections.instructions: 依據中文提示，填入適當的英文字詞

questions.q:
欲速則不達。
The ____ haste, the ____ speed.
questions.zh: 欲速則不達。
questions.explain: The more haste, the less speed. ＝ Haste makes waste.（欲速則不達）。

questions.q:
早到總比遲到好。
It is ____ to be ____ than (to be) ____.
questions.zh: 早到總比遲到好。
questions.explain:
It is better A than B（A 比 B 要好），AB 詞性需配合。
例：It is better to try it again than to give it up.（再試一次比放棄要來得好。）

questions.q:
我儘量用功讀書，使父母高興。
I study ____ hard ____ I ____ to please my parents.
questions.zh: 我儘量用功讀書，使父母高興。
questions.explain: ... as hard as [I can / possible / I possibly can]（儘量地去努力）。

questions.q:
雖然貧窮，他們依然知足而快樂。
____ poor, they were ____ content and happy.
questions.zh: 雖然貧窮，他們依然知足而快樂。
questions.explain:
① none the less ＝ all the same ＝ nevertheless（依然；仍然）。
② 原句 ＝ Though (they are) poor, they are...

questions.q:
他是你最好的朋友，再怎麼說也不會出賣你。
____ your best friend, he will be ____ person to betray you.
questions.zh: 他是你最好的朋友，再怎麼說也不會出賣你。
questions.explain:
the last ＋ 名詞 [to ＋ 原形動詞]：（最不可能；最不願意）。
例：He is the last man to tell lies.（他絕不可能說謊。）

sections.title: （四）連貫式翻譯
sections.instructions: 將下列中文句子翻譯成英文

questions.q: 大致來說，他們所飲用的水比以前髒多了。
questions.hint: ① 大致來說：generally speaking ② 髒多了：much dirtier
questions.answer: Generally speaking, the water they drink today is much dirtier than it was before.
questions.zh: 大致來說，他們所飲用的水比以前髒多了。
questions.explain:
① Generally speaking ＝ In general ＝ As a whole（大致上說；一般而言）。
② than it was ＝ than the water was。

questions.q: 為避免喝髒水，人們只得買礦泉水喝。
questions.answer: To avoid drinking dirty water, people cannot but buy mineral water to drink.
questions.zh: 為避免喝髒水，人們只得買礦泉水喝。
questions.explain: avoid ＋ V-ing（避免）。cannot but ＋ 原形動詞（只得；不得不）。

questions.q: 另外，垃圾污染更嚴重，社會治安更惡化。
questions.hint: ① 垃圾污染：garbage pollution ② 社會治安：social order
questions.answer: Besides, garbage pollution is getting more and more serious; social order is going from bad to worse.
questions.zh: 另外，垃圾污染更嚴重，社會治安更惡化。
questions.explain: go from bad to worse ＝ deteriorate（越來越糟；每況愈下）。

questions.q: 都市空氣污濁，危害人們的身心健康。
questions.hint: 身心健康：physical and mental health
questions.answer: City air is dirty and damages the physical and mental health of the people.
questions.zh: 都市空氣污濁，危害人們的身心健康。
questions.explain: 危害：damage, endanger, injure, undermine, impair。

questions.q: 政府應更加注意這些污染問題，以造福百姓。
questions.hint: ① 更加注意：pay more attention to
questions.answer: The government should pay more attention to these pollution problems for the welfare of the people.
questions.zh: 政府應更加注意這些污染問題，以造福百姓。
questions.explain:
① for the welfare of（為了…福利／福祉）。
② pay attention to（注意）。

sections.title: （五）選答案測驗
sections.instructions:
閱讀短文，並選出空格內最適當的答案：

There is a __1.__ old bell tower in Pisa, Italy. It is different from __2.__ tower in the world. This tower leans __3.__ over that it looks like it will __4.__ down. But the tower was built about seven hundred years ago. It hasn't fallen __5.__.
The people in the town of Pisa tried to fix their beautiful tower. They __6.__ out that the ground was soft __7.__ there was water in the soil. The people tried to pump the water __8.__ the ground. The pumping didn't __9.__. The tower kept __10.__ over more and more.

【詞彙及短語提示】
1. bell tower：鐘樓
2. leans [動] 傾斜
3. look like：看起來像是…
4. fix [動] 修理
5. in the soil：在泥土中
6. pumping [名] 抽吸（之工作）

questions.q: There is a ____ old bell tower in Pisa, Italy.
questions.zh: 在義大利比薩有一座令人驚訝的古老鐘樓。
questions.explain: surprising [形] 令人驚訝的；surprised [形] 人對…感到驚訝；surprise [動] 令人驚訝。

questions.q: It is different from ____ tower in the world.
questions.zh: 它不同於世界上任何其他的塔。
questions.explain: different from any other tower（不同於任何其他的鐘樓）。

questions.q: This tower leans ____ over that it looks like it will (4) down.
questions.zh: 這座塔傾斜得如此嚴重，以致於看起來快要倒塌了。
questions.explain: leans so far over that...：如此傾斜以致於…。

questions.q: ...that it looks like it will ____ down.
questions.zh: …以致於看起來快要倒塌了。
questions.explain: fall down：倒塌；倒下來。will 後接原形動詞。

questions.q: It hasn't fallen ____.
questions.zh: 但它尚未倒塌。
questions.explain: not... yet：尚未；還沒有。

questions.q: They ____ out that the ground was soft (7) there was water in the soil.
questions.zh: 他們發現地面很鬆軟…
questions.explain:
① find ─ found ─ found：發現（find out 發現）。
② found ─ founded ─ founded：建立。
③ fine ─ fined ─ fined：罰款。

questions.q: ...the ground was soft ____ there was water in the soil.
questions.zh: …地面很鬆軟，因為泥土中有水。
questions.explain: (A) 除非 (B) 雖然 (C) 因為 (D) 直到。此處表示原因，故選 because。

questions.q: The people tried to pump the water ____ the ground.
questions.zh: 人們試圖把水從地下抽吸上來。
questions.explain: pump... out of the ground：將水從地下抽吸上來。

questions.q: The pumping didn't ____.
questions.zh: 抽水並沒有起作用。
questions.explain: work [動] 起作用；發揮效力。助動詞 didn't 後接原形動詞。

questions.q: The tower kept ____ over more and more.
questions.zh: 鐘樓依然愈傾斜愈嚴重。
questions.explain: keep ＋ V-ing：持續地…；依然…。
